text.title: Learning Speed as Competitive Moat Procedure
text.summary: Step-by-step procedure for Learning Speed as Competitive Moat. Required because complexity=medium. Each step has input / action / output and (where applicable) a decision-gate. Then: Daily/weekly agent pipeline for maintaining versioned beliefs.yaml, prompt patterns with XML structure, and critical gotchas. Prompts live in 05-examples.xml, gotchas in 03-failure-modes.xml.

step.name: check-preconditions
step.input: `## Applies If` items, `## Skip If` items, prior-cycle artefact (if any).
step.action: Verify ALL applies-if items hold and NO skip-if item fires.
step.output: boolean `proceed`; if false, log skip reason and exit.
step.decision-gate: If `proceed == false`, conclude with `skip-this-methodology` and stop.

step.name: gather-inputs
step.action: Pull each input artefact from its named source; verify freshness (e.g., ≤7 days where applicable).
step.output: structured input bundle ready for step 3.
step.decision-gate: If any input missing or stale, defer the cycle and record the gap.

step.name: apply-core-rules
step.action: Apply each testable rule in order; record any rule violation with concrete evidence.

step.name: produce-artefact
step.action: Render the artefact (shape defined by JSON Schema in `02-output-contract.xml`).

step.name: validate-and-route
step.action: Run `scripts/validate-learning-speed-competitive-moat.py` against the artefact. On pass, route to downstream consumer; on fail, surface violations.
step.output: validator exit code 0 (pass) or 1 (fail) + violation list.
step.decision-gate: If exit != 0, return artefact for revision; do not advance.

step.name: run-agent-pipeline
step.input: events.ndjson, beliefs.yaml, roadmap.md, experiments.yaml; model tiers per rule separate-mechanical-from-judgment-work.
step.action: signal-collector (haiku, daily) → events.ndjson. signal-classifier (haiku/sonnet, daily) → tags evidence-for | evidence-against | new-hypothesis | noise. belief-updater (sonnet, weekly) → versioned beliefs.yaml diff. weekly-synthesizer (sonnet, Monday) → digest with cited event_ids. strategy-reviewer (opus, Friday) → keep|kill|reframe decisions with owner and check-back date. decision-logger (haiku, continuous) → prediction + check-back date per decision.
step.output: versioned beliefs.yaml diff, Monday digest, Friday keep|kill|reframe decisions, decision-log entries; prompt patterns in 05-examples.xml.
step.decision-gate: If any cited event_id is absent from events.ndjson, do not publish the belief diff (see 03-failure-modes.xml, hallucinated-event-ids).
